items.description: Disposal of shed roof timber and broken glass pane (2 pcs)
items.rationale: Both are remains of insured property, so clearance is indemnified under 5.2.1(a). This is a combined position, but both elements are indemnifiable. Price is based on Case 8, where the glass was about 32 and the timber under 75, and kept moderate.

items.description: Combined load: tree green waste, root mass over 1 m3 and excavated soil (3 pcs)
items.rationale: This is a combined position that includes ground material (5.2.1(d)) and a root mass over 1 m3 (5.2.1(e)). No reinstatement or making good of the ground occurred, so 5.2.2 is not met. Under 7.1.10 the whole position is declined.
Paving grit is ground material (1.3, 5.2.1(d)). It is disposed of as a standalone clearance with no reinstatement or making good (5.2.2), so it is not indemnified, as in Case 8.

items.description: Disposal of sieved topsoil from churned-up ground
items.rationale: Topsoil is ground material. The disposal stands alone with no reinstatement of the shed ground and no making good, so it is not indemnified under 5.2.2.
